Grouping keys remain ordinary columns reported. tab(), tab1(), tab2(), fre(), fre1(), fre2(), summ() tabstat(), .= NULL inherits existing groups; explicit .replaces . Cross-tabulation tab2() fre2() returns one table per group, list named group, Stata’s group: tab2 x y : One-way tabulations use observations within group percent cum, zero--100 scale. valid valid_cum exclude missing measured values. title: Convert vectors for data preparation — type_conversion
text: destring() (alias as_numeric()) converts text numbers, like Stata's destring. Use mutate(x = destring(x)). decode() (alias as_character()) converts labelled vector value labels, like Stata's decode. tostring() converts values text ignores value labels, like Stata's tostring: labelled vector factor gives codes, character input returned unchanged. Missing values stay NA. Dates use .character(), become "2024-01-31" rather day numbers. Character input as_numeric() parsed readr::parse_number(), preserving length. Invalid numbers generate parsing warnings. Factors return level codes; labelled numeric variables return values. as_character() uses value labels labelled vector nonempty labels attribute. Without value labels, uses ordinary character conversion, including tagged missing values. SPSS user-missing codes remain values conversions. Numeric conversion preserves tagged missing values.
